title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index (Nov 2026) — the first panel run entirely after the midterms, and the last consumer read before the December FOMC
source: EST: conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200), which states verbatim "The Conference Board publishes the Consumer Confidence Index® at 10 a.m. ET on the last Tuesday of every month" and names only "The next release is Tuesday, September 29th at 10 AM ET" — November is not named, so 2026-11-24 is cadence-derived (it is that Tuesday; 2026-11-30 is a Monday, checked by arithmetic). The rule verifies in November: the Nov 2025 edition released 2025-11-25, Nov 2022 released 2022-11-29 and Nov 2018 released 2018-11-27, each the last Tuesday of its month. It does NOT verify in December — the Conference Board's own CCI-Dec-2024 press page (fetched 2026-09-06, HTTP 200) is dated December 23, 2024 when the last Tuesday of that month was December 31 — which is why this entry stays estimate and why no December 2026 entry is filed on the same derivation. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: Canonical entry written by this id's own never-assessed research (2026-09-06), which read the single prior proposal (proposals/consumer-confidence-2026-11-24.from-fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24.json) first; that proposal is now inert. Three things make the November edition distinct from its 09-29 and 10-27 siblings. (1) Its field window — cut-off runs 7-9 days before release on the two primary-sourced precedents (Aug 2026: Aug 3-16, released 08-25; Dec 2024: cut-off 12-16, released 12-23), implying roughly 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-16 — is the first Conference Board panel conducted essentially entirely AFTER the 2026-11-03 midterms. (2) It is the last consumer-confidence read of any kind before the 2026-12-09 FOMC, since the December edition lands after the meeting whatever date it takes. (3) It is a pre-Thanksgiving print: 2026-11-24 is the Tuesday of Thanksgiving week, so the six-month buying-plans lines publish BEFORE Black Friday rather than after it — true in only 5 of the last 12 years. The shutdown-promotion case its 10-27 sibling was built on is dead: the CR was signed 2026-09-02 through 2026-12-11. Not a trade: symbols is empty, no house playbook is macro-keyed, and release-day session ranges across SPY QQQ XLY XRT AMZN AAPL and VIX closes are indistinguishable from baseline over n=68 (see the ledger).
